calls.statement:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS web_orders_placed
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-12-01'

SELECT 
  MIN(DATE(order_ts_utc)) AS earliest_order,
  MAX(DATE(order_ts_utc)) AS latest_order,
  COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(order_ts_utc)) AS distinct_order_dates
FROM fact_web_order

SELECT 
  status,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_records,
  COUNT(order_ts_utc) AS non_null_timestamps,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN order_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_timestamps
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-12-01' OR (order_ts_utc IS NULL AND DATE(CURRENT_DATE) = '2025-12-01')
